storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Comedy Story
storyTemplate.description: A light comedy start: report for a new job and survive the first ridiculous problem before lunch.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The office sign says ODDJOB SOLUTIONS in cheerful paint. The floor says someone has already spilled glue, feathers, and possibly soup.

A bell rings as you step inside. Three message slips slide off the counter, a broom falls over by itself, and the job board has one card circled in red: URGENT, SIMPLE, PROBABLY.

Your first shift has begun.

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the first odd-job shift reaches a concrete result: the player finishes the assigned task, survives the workplace chaos, is dismissed from the shift, or receives a clear pass/fail outcome from the named office contact.
